Value.Value: Comparing if aria-checked attribute value is true. If the attribute value is true, unchecks the checkbox. If the attribute value is false, checkbox is already unchecked. No action is performed.
This Subflow helps to check/uncheck the chebox with given label name.
Comparing if aria-checked attribute value is False. If the attribute value is false,checks the checkbox. If the attribute value is true, checkbox is already checked. No action is performed.
"aria-checked" attribute value of identified checkbox returns either True or False. True corresponds to Checkbox is checked. False corresponds to checkbox is unchecked.
A switch case to handle Value input.When Value = True, Set check for the checkbox. When Value = False, Set uncheck for the checkbox.
